Sara — thanks for the clear ask and great meeting. Draft MAP attached (MAP-v1.2.xlsx) and a short acceptance-tests runbook (attached PDF). Summary below — high level first, then checklist.

High-level acceptance criteria (pass = all must be green unless noted):
- Quality: 95% of clinical summary outputs rated >= 4/5 on MedFlow prompt set (50 sample cases) by SME panel.
- Hallucination rate: < 3% on the same set (defined as fabricated facts where output contradicts source records).
- Latency: median response time <= 220ms for single-request path (95th percentile <= 450ms) under pilot traffic profile.
- Throughput: sustain 200 QPS aggregate with <= 5% degradation in median latency during 5-minute sustained bursts.
- Error rate: server/5xx errors <= 0.5% over a 24h window.
- Privacy/compliance: no PHI persisted in logs beyond 24 hours for pilot; full audit logs for all requests.

Exit gates (by week):
- Week 0 (onboarding): connectivity tests, dataset ingest, and smoke run (owner: MedFlow eng + Ethan).
- Week 2 (early eval): run sample 50-case SME set; if Quality < 85% -> stop/iterate (red).
- Week 4 (midpoint): full 200-case extended eval + load test; if Latency or Error targets fail -> mitigation window (amber) and dedicated optimisation sprint.
- Week 6 (final acceptance): run regression set + security checklist; if all green -> accept and prepare SOW sign (green).

Acceptance-test suite (runbook highlights):
- Functional: correctness tests against canonical records (50 canonical cases), edge-case prompts (20), and hallucination probes (10). Owner: Marissa.
- Load/perf: ramp to 200 QPS with step increases; monitor p95, p99, and CPU/GPU utilization. Owner: Marcus.
- Resilience: node drain and failover tests, KV-cache warm/cold scenarios. Owner: Ethan.
- Security/compliance: log review, KMS key rotation check, data retention verification. Owner: Mina & Redwood Security (we will route security questionnaire separately).

Pre-reqs for MedFlow:
- Test dataset (S3 link) with 100 de-identified records — deliver by Mon EOD (EDT).
- Network: temporary VPC peering or private endpoint config (we'll send template).
- A sandbox account in your tenant for DocuSign & telemetry (we can provide).

Escalation & cadence:
- Weekly MAP sync (30m) — Tuesdays 11:00 AM EDT (starts Aug 25).
- Slack channel: #pilot-medflow (invite sent).
- Escalation: Marcus -> Mina -> Sara -> MedFlow execs.

Attachments referenced: [attachment: MAP-v1.2.xlsx (spreadsheet, 72KB)], [attachment: acceptance-tests-runbook.pdf (pdf, 540KB)].

Let me know if you want the quality thresholds looser on week 2; I proposed conservative mid-pilot checks to avoid late surprises.
